# IWhitelist
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/utils/Whitelist/IWhitelist.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IWhitelistEvents](./i-whitelist-events.md)

**Title:**
IWhitelist

Public surface of the `Whitelist` helper. Inheriting contracts gate user-facing functions
with `onlyWhitelisted(context, account)`; state lives in the central
`ProtocolAccessManagerV2` and is keyed by a `context` address (typically the vault
performing the check, e.g. the Fleet).


## Functions
### isWhitelisted

Returns whether `account` may interact with `context`.


```solidity
function isWhitelisted(address context, address account) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the check is scoped to (usually a vault address)|
|`account`|`address`|The account to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|`true` if `account` is explicitly whitelisted for `context`, or if `context`'s whitelist is globally open (`isWhitelistOpen(context) == true`).|


### isWhitelistOpen

Returns whether the whitelist for `context` is globally open (every account passes).


```solidity
function isWhitelistOpen(address context) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if every account is implicitly whitelisted for `context`.|
